name: DINXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: BlastBeats-style OPL3 FM groovebox: the published v7.1 firmware by Twisted Electrons runs unmodified on a software model of its board (YMF262 via ymfm). 6 drums, 4 four-op synths, 64-step sequencer with p-locks and songs, factory card inside. By L'Cronx; not made or endorsed by Twisted Electrons.
